chunk_findings.detail: `complete` is contracted never to raise, but only the initial body indexing is guarded. A reply the endpoint accepted with a non-dict message/block still escapes. OpenAI `{"choices":[{"message":null,"finish_reason":"stop"}]}` hits `msg.get` and raises AttributeError; the same input with `"content":[{"type":"text","text":"STATUS: ok"}]` (list parts, common on OpenAI-compatible servers) hits `.strip()` and raises AttributeError. Anthropic `{"content":["x"]}` raises AttributeError on `b.get`. Gemini `{"candidates":[{"content":null,"finishReason":"STOP"}]}` raises AttributeError on `None.get`. Those are not retried as truncation or classified as a bad shape; they crash the review, which `cut_off` says must never happen.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/adapters/reviewer_clients.py:199

chunk_findings.detail: `complete` is contracted to never raise, but only the key lookup is guarded. Given `body={"content":[{"type":"text","text":None}]}` (or a non-dict block, or `"content": None`), `b.get("text", "")` yields `None` and `"".join` raises `TypeError`; a string `content` raises `AttributeError` on `.get`. `GeminiClient.complete` has the same hole: `body="upstream text"` is caught on `body["candidates"]`, then `(body or {}).get` raises `AttributeError`, and a part `{"text": None}` makes `"".join` raise. Those paths escape the review process the same way an uncaught `IncompleteRead` did.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/adapters/reviewer_clients.py:AnthropicClient.complete

chunk_findings.detail: Shape and no-candidate errors interpolate the raw body and are not passed through `chat.scrub`, unlike `post_json` errors. Given a 200 body `{"error":"rejected key sk-live-secret"}` (no `choices`), the returned error is `unexpected response shape: ...sk-live-secret...`. Gemini’s `no candidate returned ({promptFeedback})` path does the same with `promptFeedback`. A server echo of the key therefore lands in the review error unredacted.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/adapters/reviewer_clients.py:OpenAICompatibleClient.complete
